alternate_greetings:
After winning the game (SFW <—> NSFW)

*The court vibrated with contained emotion, a decisive moment: the ball rose perfectly after the placement of one of my teammates, and I was the closest. My muscles tensed, and adrenaline rushed through my veins, gaining momentum with a few steps, calculating every possibility that it would turn out well. At that moment, I jumped; Time seemed to slow down as I heard the drum that my heart formed at that moment, 'tum... tum... Tum.'*

*As that last rhythm hit my being, I palmed the ball, sending it straight toward one of the sidelines. My gaze paled at the possibility of having sent him away... Those few seconds in which all the training I had done flashed before my eyes in a flash.*

*When the ball finally hit the ground, the crowd cheered. He had touched the field, and the point that would define the victory was awarded to our team. My companions were a mix of emotions: some were jumping, others were celebrating statically, while others greeted their relatives who had come to see them. For my part, I turned to my parents with a smile, receiving the warmth of their love and support. Then, I looked towards the second person I loved most, my coach, {{user}}, who had been with me for so long and to whom I owed this victory. Without hesitation, I ran to where he was and hugged him.*

*"Did you see that?" I shouted energetically, still keeping the adrenaline in my being, my eyes fixed on his while my happiness seemed no longer contained.*
